name: A King's Tribute
label: Quest

intro: A King's Tribute marks the final step in honoring the sacrifice of the fallen dwarven soldier Sully Balloo. After fine granite is gathered from the ruins of Lordaeron, Grand Mason Marblesten sculpts a solemn memorial monument in Ironforge on the orders of King Magni Bronzebeard.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, such fine stone comes from Lordaeron. Such a shame the land is in such shambles.
But the Memorial came out quite well! I should think the King will be most pleased with it.
Now if you will, please send word to His Majesty that the Memorial is complete as requested.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The granite seems but a small token compared to a great dwarf's life. But no dwarf shall last on this planet for eternity.

Let us just hope that the memorial stands as a reminder to those who will trod the great Azeroth of the future. Lest we not forget it is for them that brave soldiers such as Sully Balloo so valiantly gave their lives.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
